emergency.title: ⚠️ Signs that need a vet RIGHT AWAY — don't wait and watch
emergency.intro: Take your cat to a veterinary clinic immediately if you notice:
points: Your cat strains a lot but passes no urine, or only a few drops
Your cat cries, yowls or seems in pain when using the litter box
Your cat keeps going in and out of the tray but it stays dry
Your cat stops eating, vomits, is very lethargic, or has a hard, swollen belly
emergency.outro: A urinary blockage is an emergency and can be life-threatening within 24–48 hours. In these cases, don't use CatCheck to keep watching — call the nearest veterinary clinic.

hub.title: Manage your cats' profiles
hub.intro: Track each cat's indicator litter color in a multi-cat home, see the latest pH reading, and switch the cat you're tracking.
hub.quickScan: Quick-scan the litter tray for the selected cat
hub.addBody: Welcomed a new family member? Create a separate profile so each cat's scan history doesn't get mixed up.
hub.tableIntro: Compare each cat's latest scan to see which one is drifting outside the reference range.
hub.guideKicker: Tips for homes with 2 or more cats
hub.guideTitle: Separate litter trays & identify which cat just used the tray
hub.guideIntro: With several cats, it's hard to tell whose litter changed color. These three setups help every scan land on the right profile:
hub.guideStep1Body: Place trays in different quiet corners and label each tray with the cat's name. This gives the clearest results when scanning.
hub.guideStep2Title: Separate trays temporarily when you see an odd color
hub.guideStep2Body: When a scan shows an unusual color, set aside a separate tray for the cat in question for 24 hours so later scans belong to just one cat.
hub.guideStep3Body: If you see which cat just left the tray, pick that cat's name when you scan. Not sure? Choose “Unknown / Shared tray” — the result is kept separately and not mixed into any cat's history.
hub.guideNote: You're tracking {{count}} cats: set up at least {{trays}} separate litter trays in different quiet corners.
